findings: AdmittedLaunch::launch now requires execution_limit: Duration; candidate-wide search found exactly two call sites, both migrated: NativeExecutor passes its existing self.deadline and lifecycle probe passes Duration::from_secs(deadline_seconds).
The executor deadline is existing trusted configuration (constructor still rejects zero and values above 3600 seconds); no plan/request/claim field or deadline policy was added.

Final wrap uses fresh unix-ms input already taken at the final pre-spawn wrapper point, computes positive remaining time as min(permit expiry, resource lease expiry) minus now, and emits min(execution_limit.as_millis(), remaining_ms), flooring to milliseconds. Conversion follows the u128 minimum and rejects zero, so zero/sub-ms/expired values fail closed and Duration::MAX cannot overflow the bounded result.

The diff changes no claims, signed authority checks, caps, digests, custody, software wait, pending recovery, or lifecycle policy. Preflight errors still map to LaunchFailure with recovery=None before host launch; only RuntimeMaxSec construction changes in wrapper output.

Added wrapper tests cover 120s versus 380317ms, tighter permit and resource lease bounds, exact 120s, zero/sub-ms rejection, expiry boundary/past cases, 1ms flooring, near-u64 limit, Duration::MAX, and wrapper equality after normalizing the changed timer argument.
test_and_validation_limitations: No build, test, runtime, systemd, or Linux validation was performed; this is source-only review.

The historical observation in the capsule reports an approximately 17.8 second run with RuntimeMaxSec=380.317s and a configured executor deadline of 120s. That run did not exercise either timeout; this review does not qualify actual kernel enforcement, wall-clock termination, startup timing, or kill behavior.

The normalized-wrapper equality assertion checks that other wrapper fields remain equivalent while normalizing the timer argument; it is supplementary to the direct bound assertions, not independent evidence of production timeout behavior.
review_scope: Only the candidate diff for the three listed files and the frozen design capsule; no edits or external actions.
